newsitem.title: UK: JP Morgan says recommends Endesa as "buy".
newsitem.headline: JP Morgan says recommends Endesa as "buy".

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities Ltd initiated coverage of Spanish electricity generator Endesa on Friday, with a buy recommendation, the U.S. brokerage said in a statement.

"We expect Endesa to report 8.5 percent average annual earnings growth over the next five years, on the back of cost cutting measures and cost-related synergies linked with the acquisition and integration of Faeces and Sevillana in 1996," J.P. Morgan analyst Pierre Stiennon said.
Endesa, which has 49 percent of Spanish generating capacity, is 66-percent state owned but the government is studying a 20 percent public offering with an optional expansion to 33 percent.
Morgan has a 12-month price target of Pta 13,240, around 18 percent above the current share price of Pta 11,420.
